api.types: LayoutPreview{generation:u64,width:u16,height:u16,bgra:Vec<u8>,nodes:Vec<PreviewNode>}; PreviewNode{key:SceneNodeKey,parent:Option<SceneNodeKey>,rect:Rect,clip:Rect}. Coordinates must already be normalized to the preview raster.
api.clear: Window::clear_layout_preview() releases own child/image/capture and updates scrolling
api.selection: Window::set_layout_selection(Option<SceneNodeKey>)->Result<()>; purely programmatic, no Input or session renewal
api.hiddenProbe: Window::probe_layout_drag(from:(u16,u16),to:(u16,u16))->Result<()>; own hidden child only; refuses visible/busy/suppressed form.
api.events: LayoutSelect{generation,scope,id}; LayoutDrop{generation,scope,source,target,before:Option<LayoutNodeId>}; target=new parent and before=direct child or append None

behavior: Premultiplied BGRA is blended once in place over synthetic checkerboard, all output alpha255; no wallpaper/desktop sampling. LayoutPreview Debug reports dimensions/counts only, never pixel data.
At most960x540 and2MiB image bytes/capacity;128nodes; bounded finite geometry, unique scoped identities, parent integrity/cycle depth and premultiplication checked before retaining.
Native STATIC child paints actual renderer raster via StretchDIBits and separate opaque selection/hover tools; 0% raster alpha does not remove node selection.

Real mouse selects the deepest clipped node; edge drop emits parent+before precise reorder, middle drop appends into target; new parent/cursor cannot cross scope, generation or move a scope root. Final cloned-tree validation belongs to editor/domain.

Canvas replacement cancels own press/capture and drops old layout events; same generation retains cached image/selection; hide/LOCK/page structure/title changes discard picture, pending gestures and layout events.
busy and suppress reject gestures, and event drain rechecks current image generation and current busy state.
Visible canvas captures only during its mouse-down gesture and releases only if GetCapture matches own HWND; hidden diagnostic mouse path never captures/focuses/activates or sends global input.
Canvas independent of View literals, integrates existing vertical workbench scroll; child handles and paint DC/temporary brushes released by owned RAII paths.
limits: Native tests compiled but not executed by this child. Root owns unified Windows11 hidden/visible probe and Win7/10/11 matrix.
No claim of visible screenshot or actual OS input test; hidden helper dispatches SendMessage only to its own child.
This scope does not produce raster pixels: tcp_frontdoor owns native compositor producer; root supplies normalized coordinates and final session/generation integration.
